input.productDescription: Marketing landing page for a B2B human resources platform that covers employee onboarding, time off / leave management, payroll sync, and performance reviews for companies with 50 to 500 employees. Visitors are HR directors and operations leads who are actively comparing several vendors. The single page must explain what the product does, show proof (customer logos and measurable results), list integrations and pricing plans, and get the visitor to book a demo.
audience: Operations leads who own people-ops tooling
Buyers comparing several HR software vendors side by side
primaryTasks: Understand what the product covers (onboarding, time off, payroll sync, reviews)
Judge credibility through customer logos and measurable results
Check that the HRIS/payroll/accounting stack they already run is supported
Compare plans and see what each tier includes
avoid: Abstract blobs or decorative orbs as the hero visual
Headline with one italicized accent word cadence
Dashboard mockup that could be pasted onto any other product
constraints: Vite + React + plain CSS only; no UI kits, component libraries or Tailwind
No external image URLs and no stock photos; any visuals must be built from CSS/SVG/inline markup
One responsive page that works on phones and desktops
Realistic copy written for this product; no lorem ipsum

input.productContext: Demo booking form at the bottom of a B2B HR software landing page. Fields: full name, work email, company, company size band, role, current payroll provider, preferred time window. Submitting sends a request that the sales team confirms by email; there is no account or payment.
